The '''Elrooden Starport Port Authority''' was an organization operating on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Elrood/Legends|Elrood]]. It was responsible for inspecting cargo arriving on the world, and attached metal plates to them with the arrival date clearly marked.
